self_route_adjudication.why: The authority block (ree-v3/ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py:781-792) fires only when modulatory_range = (modulatory_total.max - min) across candidates > modulatory_authority_min_range_floor (1e-6). scale_factor=0.0 EXACTLY in the ON arms means that guard was False on every tick. from_dims correctly threads the flag (config.py:4049-4052 -> config.e3.use_modulatory_selection_authority=True) and the selector reads E3Config (e3_selector.py:107), so flag-not-reaching is ruled out. C0 passed on bias MAGNITUDE (~0.024 mean-abs) but the authority gate needs cross-candidate RANGE; active_frac=0.0 always => the modulatory bias is uniform across the K candidates to within 1e-6 -- a per-TICK scalar added equally to all candidates, with zero per-CANDIDATE differentiation. bias_changed_selection_frac=0.006 (C) is exact-tie epsilon, consistent with sub-floor range. The authority mechanism was never EXERCISED; it was not falsified. 'Rescaling a zero range is still zero' -- the authority-layer analogue of 604a 'scaling zero is still zero'.

learning_extracted: The modulatory-bias-selection-authority substrate (range-rescale to gain*raw_score_range) is necessary-but-not-sufficient: it cannot deliver committed authority while the upstream modulatory bias is uniform across candidates (cross-candidate range < 1e-6). The real bottleneck is one layer up -- per-candidate modulatory differentiation.

C0-style MAGNITUDE non-degeneracy does NOT establish the precondition for an authority test that gates on cross-candidate RANGE. Magnitude can be ~0.024 while range is <1e-6 (a uniform per-tick offset). The non-degeneracy check must match the gate's quantity.

Fourth convergent instance of the modulatory-signal-does-not-reach-committed-selection pattern (604a curiosity bias=0, 624a vigor v_t both arms equal, 614d within-class temperature no committed lift, 643 authority rescale starved of range) -- all share one structural property: scoring/modulatory-layer signals carry no per-candidate variance at committed selection.

A does_not_support / falsification self-route on a substrate-readiness validation must be checked against whether the mechanism actually FIRED. active_frac=0 / scale_factor=0 means the mechanism was never exercised -- a precondition_unmet, not a falsification (642 pattern, now recurring at the authority layer).

correction.summary: Autopsy root cause 'modulatory bias uniform across the K candidates / range < 1e-6' is numerically WRONG. The MECH-341 entropy bonus keys on first-action class (not z_world) and carries a genuine ~0.17 cross-candidate range -- not uniform. Binding cause is float32 CATASTROPHIC CANCELLATION: the 643 harness trains SD-056 online, exploding primary E3 scores to ~1e32; the gate's modulatory_total = scores - scores_raw subtracts two ~1e32 floats and 0.17 is below the float32 ULP (~1e25) at 1e32, so it collapses to exactly 0.0 -> gate never fired. Probe: SD-056-training-OFF raw_score_range ~4.5 -> gate fires (modrange ~0.25, active=True); ON ~1e32 -> modrange 0.0. Substrate functionally correct at normal magnitude.
